factories.name: newGetAuthenticatedProfileStep
factories.description: Read the authenticated account and its primary verified email.

inputSchema.description: GetAuthenticatedProfileInput contains the provider request fields for get authenticated profile.

factories.name: newListPublicRepositoriesStep
factories.description: List a bounded, recent-first set of public repositories owned by one login.

inputSchema.description: ListPublicRepositoriesInput contains the provider request fields for list public repositories.

limit.description: Limit specifies limit for list public repositories input.

login.description: Login specifies login for list public repositories input.

factories.name: newListMergedPullRequestsStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of pull requests merged into a public repository within a time window.

inputSchema.description: ListMergedPullRequestsInput selects one page of pull requests merged within an inclusive time window.

mergedAfter.description: MergedAfter is the inclusive window start. GitHub search receives it in UTC with second precision.

mergedBefore.description: MergedBefore is the inclusive window end and must be after MergedAfter. GitHub search receives it in UTC with second precision.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

factories.name: newListPullRequestFilesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of files changed by a public repository pull request.

inputSchema.description: ListPullRequestFilesInput selects one page of files changed by one pull request.

number.description: Number is the positive pull request number.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

factories.name: newListReleasesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of repository releases with publication dates, notes, draft and prerelease flags, and a next-page cursor. GitHub does not support a publication-date filter; callers filter PublishedAt and follow pagination without assuming publication order.

inputSchema.description: ListReleasesInput selects a single bounded page; date filtering is performed by the caller.

maxBodyCharacters.description: MaxBodyCharacters bounds each release's notes to 1 through 16384 Unicode characters. Zero selects 4000.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner.

factories.name: newListCommitsStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of public repository commits within a time window.

inputSchema.description: ListCommitsInput selects one page of commits within a time window, optionally from one ref and path.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

path.description: Path limits commits to those that changed one file or directory path.

ref.description: Ref is a branch, tag, or commit SHA. Empty selects the repository default branch.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

since.description: Since is the window start. GitHub receives it as since, in UTC with second precision.

until.description: Until is the window end and must be after Since. GitHub receives it as until, in UTC with second precision.

factories.name: newListIssuesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of a repository's issues, newest created first, filtered by state, labels, creator, and last update. GitHub's issue list reads without the search index's delay, so an issue created a moment ago is listed; pull requests are left out.

inputSchema.description: ListIssuesInput selects one page of a repository's issues, newest created first.

creator.description: Creator keeps only issues opened by this GitHub login.

labels.description: Labels keeps only issues that carry every listed label name. A name cannot contain a comma, because GitHub receives the list comma-separated.

maxBodyCharacters.description: MaxBodyCharacters bounds each issue body to 1 through 16384 Unicode characters. Zero selects 4000.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

state.description: State is open, closed, or all. Empty selects open.

updatedSince.description: UpdatedSince keeps only issues updated at or after this time. GitHub receives it in UTC with second precision.

factories.name: newCreateIssueStep
factories.description: Create one issue in a public or private repository with a title, Markdown body, labels, and assignees, on a github-oauth-repository connection. GitHub has no idempotency key, so the body carries a hidden marker derived from the Call ID; after an unknown outcome a retry lists the repository's newest issues by the connection's account and returns the marked issue instead of creating another, and resends only while the send cap allows.

inputSchema.description: CreateIssueInput describes one issue to create.

assignees.description: Assignees lists up to 10 GitHub logins. GitHub applies assignees only for an account with push access and drops them silently otherwise; CreatedIssue.Assignees lists the assignees applied.

body.description: Body is the Markdown issue body. The connector appends a hidden HTML comment that marks the issue for read-back, so Body holds at most 65536 characters less that marker; empty sends only the marker.

labels.description: Labels names up to 100 labels of 1 through 50 characters. GitHub applies labels only for an account with push access and drops them silently otherwise; CreatedIssue.Labels lists the labels applied.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

title.description: Title is the issue title, 1 through 256 Unicode characters after surrounding whitespace is trimmed, without line breaks or other control characters.

factories.name: newSetIssueStateStep
factories.description: Close or reopen one existing issue in a public or private repository, with an optional state reason, on a github-oauth-repository connection. Setting an absolute state is safe to repeat, so an unknown outcome sends the same update again.

inputSchema.description: SetIssueStateInput names one existing issue and the state to set.

issueNumber.description: IssueNumber is the positive issue number within the repository.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

stateReason.description: StateReason is completed or not_planned with State closed, or reopened with State open. Empty lets GitHub choose: completed for a close and reopened for a reopen. Setting the same state with another reason changes only the reason.

factories.name: newReplaceIssueLabelsStep
factories.description: Replace every label on one existing issue with the given label names, on a github-oauth-repository connection; an empty list removes all labels. Replacing the full set is safe to repeat, so an unknown outcome sends the same set again.

inputSchema.description: ReplaceIssueLabelsInput names one existing issue and the complete label set it should carry.

issueNumber.description: IssueNumber is the positive issue number within the repository.

labels.description: Labels names up to 100 labels of 1 through 50 characters that replace every current label; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and an empty list removes all labels. GitHub creates a named label the repository lacks.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.

factories.name: newCreateIssueCommentStep
factories.description: Add one Markdown comment to an existing issue in a public or private repository, on a github-oauth-repository connection. GitHub has no idempotency key, so the body carries a hidden marker derived from the Call ID; after an unknown outcome a retry reads the issue's newest comments by the connection's account and returns the marked comment instead of posting another, and resends only while the send cap allows.

inputSchema.description: CreateIssueCommentInput describes one comment to add to an existing issue.

body.description: Body is the nonblank Markdown comment. The connector appends a hidden HTML comment that marks the comment for read-back, so Body holds at most 65536 characters less that marker.

issueNumber.description: IssueNumber is the positive issue number within the repository.

owner.description: Owner is the GitHub login that owns the repository. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

repository.description: Repository is the repository name without its owner, such as hello-world.
